For Respondent(s) : Mr. Farzand Ali, AAG-cum-GA with  Mr. B.R. Bishnoi, AGC.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP MEHTA Order 01/03/2021 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Perused the material available on record.

The petitioners herein have approached this Court by way of this misc. petition for assailing the order dated 21.07.2016 passed by the learned ACJM, Mavli, District Udaipur in Criminal Case No.100/2010 (State vs. Mahendra Sahu & Ors) whereby, charge was directed to be framed against the petitioners herein for the (2 of 3) [CRLMP-2609/2018] offence under Section 7(1)/15 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
Learned counsel Shri Jain urges that the petitioners had filed an application for reanalysis of the food article from the Central Food Laboratory.

sentences.text: The fervent contention of learned counsel Shri Jain is that the sample of the food article (dairy creamer) does not violate the standards prescribed in the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules and the appendices thereto.

He urges that the learned ACJM, while considering the aspect of framing of charges, failed to refer to the report of the CFL and thus, the impugned order is bad in the eyes of law and same deserves to be quashed and set aside.

Learned Public Prosecutor, on the other hand, submits that CFL report might have escaped the notice of the court but this cannot be a ground to discharge the accused because in the CFL report also, it has been mentioned that the sample did not conform to the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1955.

Nonetheless, learned Public Prosecutor is not in a position to dispute the fact that CFL report does not mention as to which particular clause of the Rules was being violated on the basis of the analyais carried out.
It is also not disputed that the trial court failed to advert to the CFL report while directing framing of charges against the accused petitioners.
In this view the matter, I am of the firm opinion that the matter is required to be remanded back to the trial court for fresh consideration on the aspect of framing of charges.
Thus, the impugned order dated 21.07.2016 passed by the learned ACJM, Mavli, District Udaipur in Criminal Case No.100/2010 is hereby quashed and set aside.
The matter is remanded to the learned trial court to pass a fresh order on the aspect of framing of charges after conscious consideration of the Central Food Laboratory report dated 07.09.2011.
With the above observations and directions, the misc. petition is allowed.
Record be returned to the trial court forthwith.

(SANDEEP MEHTA),J 78-Tikam/-
